title: Institutional Seal — Still Life
purpose: Brand still-life accent (the 'Official Publication' object / closing seal device).
story: The instrument of authority at rest — a heavy seal press and a sealed dark volume, the moment a record becomes official.
environment: A dark study desk, bookshelves dissolving into shadow behind.
architecture: Implied only — a quiet panelled room beyond the pool of light.
composition: A single brass seal press and a sealed leather volume isolated against deep shadow; one specular highlight on the brass; deep negative space.
negativeExtra: any engraved words on the seal
continuityNotes: Same warm pooled light and brass-on-black palette as scene-01; the seal's blank face must carry no letters or numbers.
